## Complete Settings & Configuration Reference for `code-agent`

### Overview

The project has **two distinct settings systems**:
1. **Global application settings** — `application.properties` / env vars, with a DB override layer (`agent_settings` table)
2. **Per-repository settings** — stored in the `repo_settings` table, managed via REST

---

## 1. Global Application Settings (`application.properties`)

**File:** `src/main/resources/application.properties`

All properties support environment variable overrides using the pattern `${ENV_VAR:default}`.

## 2. DB-Backed Runtime Settings — `agent_settings` Table

**Schema:** `src/main/resources/db/migration/V27__create_agent_settings.sql`

```sql
CREATE TABLE agent_settings (
    key         VARCHAR(255) PRIMARY KEY,
    value       TEXT         NOT NULL,
    is_secret   BOOLEAN      NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    description TEXT,
    created_at  TIMESTAMP    NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    updated_at  TIMESTAMP    NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);
```

Any key from `application.properties` can be overridden at runtime via the `PUT /settings/{key}` API. Secret values are stored as `Base64(IV[12] || ciphertext || GCM-tag[16])` (AES-256-GCM). The key format matches MicroProfile Config (e.g. `anthropic.api.key`).

**Relevant classes:**
- `src/main/java/com/eneve/agent/settings/SettingsService.java` — read/write with in-memory cache
- `src/main/java/com/eneve/agent/settings/SettingsStore.java` — JDBC DAO
- `src/main/java/com/eneve/agent/settings/SettingsEncryption.java` — AES-256-GCM
- `src/main/java/com/eneve/agent/settings/SettingRow.java` — DB row record
- `SettingsService.SettingView` — API response DTO (secrets masked as `****`)
- `SettingsService.UpsertRequest` — request body record: `{ value, isSecret, description }`

## 3. REST Endpoints — Global Settings

**Controller:** `src/main/java/com/eneve/agent/SettingsResource.java`  
**Base path:** `/settings`

| Method | Path | Description | Request Body | Response |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `GET` | `/settings` | List all DB-stored settings | — | `SettingView[]` (secrets masked) |
| `GET` | `/settings/{key}` | Get single setting | — | `SettingView` or 404 |
| `PUT` | `/settings/{key}` | Create/update a setting | `{ "value": "...", "isSecret": bool, "description": "..." }` | `{ action, key, isSecret }` |
| `DELETE` | `/settings/{key}` | Delete DB override (reverts to env/properties) | — | `{ action, key }` or 404 |

## 5. REST Endpoints — Per-Repository Settings

**Controller:** `src/main/java/com/eneve/agent/RepoSettingsResource.java`  
**Base path:** `/settings/repos`

### CRUD

| Method | Path | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `GET` | `/settings/repos` | List all configured repositories |
| `GET` | `/settings/repos/{workspace}/{repoSlug}` | Get settings for a specific repo |
| `PUT` | `/settings/repos/{workspace}/{repoSlug}` | Create or fully replace repo settings |
| `DELETE` | `/settings/repos/{workspace}/{repoSlug}` | Delete all settings for a repo (revert to defaults) |

**PUT request body** (`UpsertRepoSettingsRequest` record):
```json
{
  "reviewEnabled": true,
  "vectorEnabled": false,
  "docsEnabled": true,
  "upgradeEnabled": true,
  "qualityReportEnabled": false,
  "archived": false,
  "ruleNames": ["rule1", "rule2"],
  "reviewPrompt": "...",
  "disabledHooks": [],
  "confluenceSpaceKey": "MYSPACE",
  "confluenceParentPageId": "123456",
  "gitPlatformUrl": "https://gitlab.mycompany.com"
}
```

### Toggle Shortcuts (PATCH)

| Method | Path | operationId |
|---|---|---|
| `PATCH` | `/settings/repos/{workspace}/{repoSlug}/enable` | `enableRepoReview` |
| `PATCH` | `/settings/repos/{workspace}/{repoSlug}/disable` | `disableRepoReview` |
| `PATCH` | `/settings/repos/{workspace}/{repoSlug}/vector/enable` | `enableRepoVector` |
| `PATCH` | `/settings/repos/{workspace}/{repoSlug}/vector/disable` | `disableRepoVector` |
| `PATCH` | `/settings/repos/{workspace}/{repoSlug}/docs/enable` | `enableRepoDocs` |
| `PATCH` | `/settings/repos/{workspace}/{repoSlug}/docs/disable` | `disableRepoDocs` |
| `PATCH` | `/settings/repos/{workspace}/{repoSlug}/upgrade/enable` | `enableRepoUpgrade` |
| `PATCH` | `/settings/repos/{workspace}/{repoSlug}/upgrade/disable` | `disableRepoUpgrade` |
| `PATCH` | `/settings/repos/{workspace}/{repoSlug}/quality-report/enable` | `enableRepoQualityReport` |
| `PATCH` | `/settings/repos/{workspace}/{repoSlug}/quality-report/disable` | `disableRepoQualityReport` |
| `PATCH` | `/settings/repos/{workspace}/{repoSlug}/archive` | `archiveRepo` |
| `PATCH` | `/settings/repos/{workspace}/{repoSlug}/unarchive` | `unarchiveRepo` |

All PATCH endpoints return `200 { action, workspace, repoSlug }` or `404` if the repo is not configured.

## 6. Key Architecture Notes

- **Override priority:** in-memory cache → `agent_settings` DB table → `application.properties` / env vars
- **Cache TTL:** 30 seconds by default (`settings.cache.ttl-seconds`). Changes take effect within one TTL without restart.
- **Secret rotation:** Any secret key (e.g. `api.key`, `webhook.secret.bitbucket`) can be live-rotated via `PUT /settings/{key}` with `isSecret: true`, without redeploying.
- **Encryption:** AES-256-GCM; requires `SETTINGS_ENCRYPTION_KEY` (64-char hex). Without it, secret storage is disabled.
- **Webhook sync:** Enabling/disabling review or archiving a repo automatically syncs webhooks on the SCM platform.
